svg.text: Runs the model explicitly named in the request.

A JSON list of durable facts.

User ID and profile fields; the email domain decides.
Access granted or denied; the key is handed back to a loopback callback.
Nothing remote — a transient local server receives the key.
The API key, in a query parameter.
The supported-provider list, or an error.
Reports balance, tier and credit state.
Reports configured budgets and spend against them.
Budget entries; a 404 means "no budget configured".
Applies configured spending limits to requests.
Aggregates usage, costs and productivity measurements.
Aggregates the same data per metric.
Declared by the client; never invoked.
Authorizes the key and names the org it belongs to.
{organizationId}, and a userID the client never reads.

Status, resources, and the worker uri.
Creates or updates a workspace, idempotently.
The full workspace record, including uri; since 1.1.34 its sizes are read from

Nothing the client reads on success.

A map keyed by session name.
Session status; 404 means it is gone.

Splices raw bytes for an ssh ProxyCommand.

An answer from the fallback model.

is_serverless is the only signal, and it does not mark a self-hosted deployment.
